paragraphs: For centuries, it held the SETTLED DARK together through fear, tribute, and overwhelming force. Its officials sold justice. Its fleets crushed dissent. Its peace was bought with the lives of those who refused to kneel.

Now, old agreements unravel and ancient trade routes decay. The NOBLE HOUSES settle old grudges with open war. Those who paid for the CONCLAVE’s protection find themselves paying again for its collapse.

Far from the centres of power, on the fringes of settled space, news travels slowly. Ships go missing. Dark deals are made. A stranger arriving at the dock might bring supplies, a warning, or trouble enough for everyone.
Out here, the law was always distant. You and your crew learned to look after your own.
Now, with only your ship and each other, you must stand alone—
